# reselling_image_recipe (Resource)

An image builder recipe: a Linux base system, ordered steps and the size of the temporary build VM. Builds are started through the API or the panel; they are not managed by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_image_recipe" "base" {
  name          = "base"
  os_version_id = data.reselling_os_versions.debian.versions[0].id
  cores         = 2
  ram           = 2048
  disk          = 20

  step {
    type              = "startup_script"
    startup_script_id = reselling_startup_script.docker.id
  }

  step {
    type    = "user_data"
    content = <<-EOT
      #cloud-config
      packages: [htop]
    EOT
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cores` (Number)
- `disk` (Number) GB (10-1000).
- `name` (String)
- `os_version_id` (String) Linux base system of the catalogue.
- `ram` (Number) MB (512-65536).

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `step` (Block List) Ordered build steps; at least one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--step))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--step"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step`

Required:

- `type` (String) `startup_script` or `user_data`.

Optional:

- `content` (String) cloud-init document for type `user_data`.
- `startup_script_id` (String) For type `startup_script`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_image_recipe.base <recipe_id>
```
